_about: Texts of the shared blocks in common/ (Discord bot), shipped by Seedbox and Sysbox as mtlang/

bot.h.band.note: band title of the shared bot block (Seedbox Tools settings and Claude Guard page)

bot.ph.token.note: placeholder of the token field when none is saved

bot.ph.saved.text: saved, leave empty to keep it
bot.ph.saved.note: placeholder of the token field when a token is saved

bot.ph.user.note: placeholder of the user id field

bot.hint.token.text: Discord Developer Portal, your app, Bot, Reset Token. Leave empty to keep the saved one, - removes it. The bot needs View Channel, Add Reactions and Read Message History in the channel of the webhooks. It always shows offline: that is normal, it only adds and reads reactions.
bot.hint.token.note: grey hint under the token field

bot.hint.user.text: Only your reactions count. Discord, Settings, Advanced, Developer Mode, then right-click your name, Copy User ID.
bot.hint.user.note: grey hint under the user id field

bot.hint.foot.text: One bot for Seedbox and Sysbox: saved here, it is saved for both.
bot.hint.foot.note: grey line next to the Save button

bot.btn.test.note: button: sends a test message with this plugin's webhook and lets the bot react under it

bot.st.on.note: state on the right of the band

bot.st.off.note: state on the right of the band

bot.st.no_user.note: state on the right of the band

bot.saved_off.note: result of Save bot when the token was removed

bot.e.token.text: The bot token looks wrong (Developer Portal, Bot, Reset Token).

bot.e.user.text: The user ID is a number of 15 to 25 digits.

bot.e.write.text: Could not write the setting to the flash drive.

bot.t.token.text: The bot token does not work: {e}
bot.t.token.note: result of Test the bot ({e} Discord's error)

bot.t.no_hook.text: {p} has no Discord webhook: save one in its settings first.
bot.t.no_hook.note: result of Test the bot ({p} plugin name)

bot.t.hook.text: The webhook did not take the test message: {e}
bot.t.hook.note: result of Test the bot ({e} the error)

bot.t.react.text: The bot could not react (View Channel and Add Reactions in that channel?): {e}
bot.t.react.note: result of Test the bot ({e} Discord's error)

bot.t.read.text: The bot could not read the reactions (Read Message History?): {e}
bot.t.read.note: result of Test the bot ({e} Discord's error)

bot.t.ok.text: It works: {bot} reacted under the test message and can read the reactions.
bot.t.ok.note: result of Test the bot ({bot} the bot's name)

bot.t.no_user.text: Save your user ID too, otherwise no reaction counts.
bot.t.no_user.note: added to a successful test when the user id is empty

bot.d.desc.text: If a ✅ from {bot} appears under this message, the bot can react here. Nothing else happens.
bot.d.desc.note: Discord message text ({bot} the bot's name)
